data.fund_type: An open ended scheme investing in arbitrage opportunities
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to seek to generate returns by investing in arbitrage opportunities in the cash and derivatives segments of the equity markets and by investing balance in debt and money market instruments. However, there is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equities & Equity related instruments including derivatives and stock options- 100%-65%, Debt & Money Market instruments including the margin money deployed in derivative transactions -35%-0% Non- convertible preference shares-10%-0%
data.fund_managers: FM 1 - Mr. Chetan Chavan (Equity portion), FM 2 - Mr. Ilesh Savla (Equity portion), FM 3 - Mr. Siddharth Chaudhary (Debt portion)
data.exit_load: Entry load – not applicable Exit load – 0.25% of applicable NAV if redeemed/switched out within 15 days from the date of allotment. Nil if redeemed/switched out after 15 days from the date of allotment.
